headline: Sensex and Nifty surge nearly 1% as lower oil prices and foreign inflows boost market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Decline in global oil prices boosting market sentiment
Optimism regarding foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows
Positive corporate earnings reports for the second quarter
Strong performance in financial and auto sectors
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,300 points and Nifty crossed the 25,350 mark
Investors gained ₹4.5 lakh crore in wealth shortly after market opening
Qualcomm India is reportedly planning to lay off over 1,000 employees
India's 10-year bond faced its worst day in a month due to a US Treasury rout
summary: Indian markets rallied sharply with the Sensex gaining over 1,300 points, driven by lower oil prices and foreign investor optimism. Financial and auto sectors led the gains, adding ₹4.5 lakh crore to investor wealth within minutes of the market opening. In corporate news, Fairfax is reportedly planning to sell its stake in IIFL Finance to fund the purchase of IDBI Bank.
